register: Casual speech often shortens 食べられる to 食べれる (ら抜き).

examples.reading: なっとうがたべられない。
ひとりでこられますか。

usage: The object often takes が instead of を: 日本語が話せる.
Dropping ら (食べれる) is common in speech but is not accepted in formal writing.
Only verbs you control have a potential. ある does not.

compare.difference: ことができる is longer and more formal. Use the potential verb in everyday speech.
For ichidan verbs the shape is the same as the passive. Check the particles to tell them apart.
